title: Read the Sign
subtitle: The first button in the book
description: The sign at the crossroads says the road down was closed in spring,
which was true then. Read it anyway. Somebody went to the trouble of
carving it, and the carving is the only census the road will ever
A checkmark task is nothing but the button -- the game cannot see you
read, so the press is the doing. The `title` field is what the button
says, which is the one place a task gets to choose its own label.
